source_authorship: Mechanical Crypto Lab adaptation of publicly attributed Fabrício Lorenz Realização Frustrada; not an exact copy of inaccessible paid video lessons
instrument: BINANCE USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual price research only
rf_buy: 3 completed hourly candles down/up/down, strict close-vs-open
rf_sell: 3 completed hourly candles up/down/up, strict close-vs-open
trend_definition_origin: Lab-defined, NOT claimed as author's exact rule
entry_timing: Only next 3 full 1h bars after signal close; cancel pending if protective stop touched first
gap_rule: Adverse entry gap filled at open; adverse exit gap at open; favorable target gap capped at target
intraminute_ambiguous: If entry and protective stop touched in same 1m bar, assume fill and stop, pessimistically
exit_target: 1R from actual entry fill to fixed protective stop, research tick rounded
timeout_price: 1m candle close at last allowed minute
serialization: Independent RF and trend baseline, one pending/position at a time in each
end_boundary: Skip setups missing full 28h runway before Jan 1 2025
baseline: EMA9/SMA21/SMA200 same trend+price and 3 bar extrema entry/stop/1R rules, without RF polarity requirement
cost_note: Conservative research hurdles; NOT broker fee/funding/fill certification; passing does NOT prove executable economics
primary_unit: equal-weight net bps per executed trade; no compound
bootstrap: UTC ISO week blocks with replacement, 2000 repeats, RF seed=20261009, uplift seed=20261010
primary_survival_gate: ALL: mean RF net26>0; mean RF net40>0; 95% week block lower CI net26>0; PF net26>=1.15; at least 3 positive of 4 represented quarters; RF minus baseline mean net26>=5bps and paired-week bootstrap 95% CI lower>0; max single ISO week share of RF positive-net PnL<=25%
anti_rescue: No post-outcome changes to side, year, costs, timeframe, fills, trend definition, signal, target, stop, controls, risk, bootstrap or venue. 2025 can open only following separate review; 2026 sealed.
